name: Saint Mary-of-the-Woods College
academic_ranking: Private Catholic liberal arts college in Indiana (teams known as the Pomeroys). U.S. News & World Report consistently ranks SMWC among the best baccalaureate colleges in the Midwest. Serves campus-based undergraduates, online undergraduates, and graduate students; motto 'Virtue and Knowledge United'.
financial_aid: All part-time and full-time students are considered for institutional awards. Financial Aid office: (812) 535-5100 / financialaid@smwc.edu.
facilities_notes: Softball plays at the SMWC Softball Field (on-campus). Athletic training support provided by the SMWC athletic training staff.
program_reputation: NAIA program competing in the River States Conference (RSC).
notes: Data sourced live from smwcathletics.com softball coaches and roster pages and smwc.edu (2026-07). Roster size from 2027 softball roster page (18 players). Tuition is 2026-2027 full-time undergraduate rate. Note: a novelty/mascot entry 'Andre The Alpaca - Emotional Support Coach' appears on the coaches page and was excluded as it is not an actual staff member. Only the head coach has a public email listed; assistant coaches have no public contact info listed.
